situation: It is night. A loud crash comes from the dark cellar. Nobody else is awake.

criteria.investigate: Goes down into the cellar alone to see what it was.
criteria.hide: Stays in bed and pulls the blanket up.
criteria.wake_someone: Wakes another hob to deal with it.

situation: Pim, a much bigger hob, is shoving little Ottoline away from the stove.

criteria.step_in: Gets between them and tells Pim to stop.
criteria.walk_away: Leaves the room so as not to get involved.

situation: The ice on the pond looks thin. The best fishing spot is on the far side, straight across it. Walking around takes an hour.

criteria.true: Walks straight across the thin ice.

situation: {name} has finished at the workbench. Shavings and tools are everywhere. The supper bell rings.

criteria.clean_up: Sweeps up and puts the tools back before going to supper.
criteria.leave_it: Goes to supper and leaves the bench as it is.

situation: Someone has left muddy tracks through the hall. Cleaning the hall is not {name}'s job today.
instructions: Does {name} stop and mop the tracks?

situation: {name} is carrying an armful of sticks and drops three in the doorway.

criteria.pick_up: Puts the load down and picks up the dropped sticks.
criteria.keep_walking: Keeps walking and leaves them in the doorway.

situation: {name} has two fish and has already eaten today. Pim has not eaten since yesterday and asks for one.

criteria.give_fish: Hands Pim a fish and asks for nothing.
criteria.refuse: Says no and keeps both fish.
criteria.trade: Offers the fish only in exchange for something.

situation: It is winter. The machine put out an extra blanket by mistake and {name} is holding it. {name} already has a blanket. Ottoline has none.
instructions: Does {name} keep the extra blanket for itself?

situation: {name} has found a full jar of honey that nobody else knows about.

criteria.share: Brings it to supper for everyone.
criteria.hide_it: Hides it somewhere only it knows.

situation: A sealed box with strange markings has arrived on the rail. It has no label and nobody is expecting anything.

criteria.open_it: Opens the box to see what is inside.
criteria.ask_others: Goes to ask the others about it first.

situation: A blue mushroom nobody has seen before is growing by the pond.

criteria.true: Takes a bite to find out what it is like.

situation: {name} has a free afternoon. The path past the meadow goes somewhere no hob has ever been.

criteria.explore: Follows the path to see where it goes.
criteria.stay_home: Spends the afternoon at the house as usual.

situation: It is supper. The long table is full of chatter. There is also an empty stool by the window, away from everyone.

criteria.join_table: Squeezes in at the long table.
criteria.sit_alone: Takes the stool by the window.

situation: Three hobs are singing in the hall and wave {name} over. {name} was on its way to the workshop; the work can wait.
{name} has a long weaving job. Ottoline offers to sit and work alongside.

criteria.accept: Says yes and they work together.
criteria.decline: Says it would rather do it alone.

situation: {name} cracked the shared kettle this morning. Nobody saw. Now the others are blaming Pim.

criteria.confess: Says it was the one who cracked the kettle.
criteria.stay_quiet: Says nothing and lets Pim take the blame.

situation: Ottoline left her good knife on the bench and went to bed. {name}'s own knife is dull.
instructions: Does {name} take Ottoline's knife for itself?

criteria.true: Takes the knife and keeps it.

situation: The machine gave {name} three coins too many in a trade. Nobody noticed.
{name}'s clay pot needs another hour in the kiln to be strong. Taken out now it will hold water but may crack within the month.

criteria.wait: Leaves the pot in for the full hour.
criteria.take_it_out: Takes the pot out now and uses it.

situation: Four hobs are queueing at the machine. {name} only wants one small thing.

criteria.wait_in_line: Joins the back of the queue.
criteria.push_in: Goes to the front and pushes in.

situation: {name} is mending a net. The careful knot takes ten times as long as the quick knot. The quick knot will come apart within a week.
{name} is carrying firewood. Pim throws a snowball at it and grins.

criteria.throw_back: Drops the wood and throws one back.

situation: {name} has a long job sorting seeds into jars.
instructions: Does {name} turn the job into a game?

criteria.true: Makes a game or a joke of it while working.

situation: The little hobs ask {name} to play hide and seek. {name} has work left to do, none of it urgent.

criteria.decline: Says no and gets on with the work.

situation: The house needs someone to learn the forge, the hardest job there is. {name} has an easy, comfortable job gathering berries.
Ottoline's pot was judged the best in the house today. {name} also makes pots.
instructions: Does {name} stay up tonight practising to beat her?

situation: It is a warm afternoon and {name}'s work is done. It could start building a better fishing rod, or lie in the sun.
Pim walks past {name} at supper and says, "That's a lot of fish for one hob."
instructions: Does {name} take this as an insult?

criteria.true: Hears it as a dig and is offended.
criteria.false: Hears it as a harmless remark.

situation: Yesterday Ottoline bumped into {name} and broke its favourite cup. Today she says she is sorry.

criteria.forgive: Tells her it is all right.
criteria.hold_grudge: Turns away and stays angry with her.

situation: {name} trips over a bucket in front of everyone. Pim laughs.
Ottoline walks past {name} this morning without saying good morning.
instructions: Does {name} think she ignored it on purpose?

criteria.false: Assumes she was distracted or didn't see it.

situation: Two hobs stop talking when {name} walks into the room.
instructions: Does {name} think they were talking about it?

criteria.true: Assumes they were talking about it behind its back.

situation: It is dusk. Something moves at the edge of the woods.
instructions: Does {name} think it is something dangerous?

criteria.false: Assumes it is the wind or a small animal.

situation: The house spoon has been missing for a week. Pim says he just found it under the stove.

criteria.false: Suspects Pim had it all along.

situation: Ottoline hands {name} a whole pie and gives no reason.
instructions: Does {name} think she wants something in return?

criteria.false: Takes it as a simple gift.

situation: Pim has hidden {name}'s hat and is waiting nearby, giggling.
A wasp nest has appeared above the door everyone uses.

criteria.knock_it_down: Gets a stick and deals with the nest itself.
criteria.use_window: Climbs in and out through the window from now on.

situation: It is midday. {name} got out of bed hours ago.

criteria.true: The bed is made and the blanket folded.
criteria.false: The blanket is in a heap.

situation: It is {name}'s turn to cut the cake for six hobs, itself included.

criteria.big_own: Five slices and one noticeably bigger one for itself.

situation: The radio has started making a noise it has never made before. It still works.
instructions: Does {name} take the back off to look inside?

situation: It rains all day and there is no work.

criteria.hall: In the hall where the others are.
criteria.loft: Up in the loft by itself.

situation: {name} ate the last pie. Ottoline asks whether {name} saw who ate it.
The berries by the fence will be ripe and sweet in three days. Today they are edible but sour.
Supper is soup, served too hot to eat.

criteria.true: Starts eating straight away and burns its tongue.

situation: After the rain there is a big puddle in the yard. {name} is crossing the yard on an errand.
{name} is asked to name the new goat.
instructions: What kind of name does {name} give it?

criteria.silly_name: Something ridiculous that makes the others laugh.
criteria.plain_name: Something plain and sensible, like Brown.

situation: The board lists two open jobs. Mending the fence takes a morning. Designing the new house takes a whole season and might come to nothing.
instructions: Which does {name} put its name to?

situation: Ottoline has knocked {name}'s soup onto the floor by accident and looks horrified.

criteria.reassure: Tells her not to worry about it.
